name: Armor Cache for Set of Infinite Madness grants its wrists piece too (#12194)
contract: ItemSet.dbc 61889 (Set of Infinite Madness) has nine pieces: 774033-774041, where 774041 is the wrists piece (InventoryType 9). VanityCollection.dbc row 68366 for cache 774042 listed only 774033-774040, so 06_ethereal_bazaar_set_caches.sql omitted 774041. rev_20261126_12194 adds (774042, 774041, 8, 1) to ethereal_bazaar_set_cache. Expected: opening cache 774042 hands out all nine pieces including wrists 774041 and consumes the cache.

steps.label: An 18-slot bag for the nine pieces
SETUP: at least nine slots are free
Open the Set of Infinite Madness cache
the cache opens without being refused
DISCRIMINATING: wrists piece 774041 is handed out
